description: La Vega Estate, located in Central Trinidad, is a 250-acre hideaway that offers outdoor recreational opportunities for the entire family. La Vega, once a cocoa plantation, is now a unique blend of garden center, plant nursery, nature preserve, and recreation area. Listed opening hours: Monday - Sunday: 9:00am - 5:00pm Including weekends and public holidays.. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
